discussion_comments.comment_body:
@yusukebe Oh, I see.

It is customary for a function named `jsx` to be exported from '*/jsx-runtime’. I think that [this](https://github.com/honojs/honox/blob/a186c42bfd35c05954df614078e89fcb19c1263c/src/client/client.ts#L2C1-L2C56) is acceptable to use. 

```ts
import { jsx } from "react/jsx-runtime";
console.log(jsx('div', {}, 'Hello, World!'))
```

```ts
import { jsx } from "preact/jsx-runtime";
console.log(jsx('div', {}, 'Hello, World!'))
```


Also, since `jsx` is an optimized version of `createElement`, I think it is not a bad idea to use `import { jsx as jsxFn } from '*/jsx-runtime'` instead of `createElement`.


### About HonoX

I don't think the current code that I am importing from hono/jsx/dom/jsx-runtime will result in minimal output and I don't think it is bad usage. But on the other hand,  you are right, `import { createElement } from 'hono/jsx/dom'` also makes sense since it is intended to be used as a `createElement`.

I see no problem either way.
